problems.problem: Northwest Roof Restoration, LLC operates in the roofing trade rather than ForgeX's target trades (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical).
problems.label: fact
problems.basis: Stated across https://nwroof.net/ that the company is an 'Everything Roofing' contractor offering roof repair, installation, maintenance, and inspections.

problems.problem: Web form estimate inquiries and after-hours storm damage requests may require manual follow-up and routing across the Meridian and Post Falls locations.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The site uses a basic Weblium contact form (us-central1-weblium-contact-form-app.cloudfunctions.net) and embed.tawk.to, with no visible field-service management or automated scheduling integration on the public pages.

existingSolutions.solution: embed.tawk.to widget and Weblium contact form app
existingSolutions.addresses: Basic online visitor chat and web form lead capture

existingSolutions.solution: Roofing-specific CRM / field-service software native lead intake and estimating tools
existingSolutions.addresses: Lead capture, roof measurement/estimating, and insurance claim workflow management

feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is a roofing contractor outside ForgeX's target segment of HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors.

aiDelivery.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended as the company is outside ForgeX's target industry segment.

humanReview: No implementation is recommended; if the founder ever expands into roofing contractors, any roof estimate, insurance documentation, or emergency dispatch commitment would require human review.

risks.description: Pursuing a roofing contractor falls outside ForgeX's defined core segment (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors with 10 to 75 staff), which risks misaligning standardized connectors and workflows.

assumptions: The website states 'Estimates are free' and lists no service prices, average ticket values, lead volumes, or employee headcount, so commercial value cannot be calculated from site data.

questions: How many full-time staff and crews do you currently run across your Meridian and Post Falls locations?
What CRM or roofing software do you currently use to track estimate requests and insurance jobs?
How are inquiries from your website forms and live chat currently routed after hours or during storms?

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identity, locations, roofing services offered, FAQs, phone contact channel, and embedded technical hosts.
Business hours, physical addresses in Meridian and Post Falls, contact form fields, and ownership tenure.
Verification of residential roofing installation services and materials.
Verification of commercial roofing services, state compliance roof inspections, and commercial roof systems.
Verification of Treasure Valley and North Idaho cities served.
Verification of data collection disclosures and privacy policy details.
Verification of emergency roof tarping, leak repair, and storm/insurance documentation services.
Verification of asphalt shingle replacement and repair services.

limitations: The website does not disclose employee headcount or crew size (cannot confirm whether staff count is between 10 and 75).
The website does not name the owner, executives, or managers.
The website does not disclose state contractor license numbers.
The website does not disclose internal back-office, accounting, or field-service software.
The website does not publish service pricing, average job values, or paid lead generation spend.

qualification.rationale: ForgeX's target segment is owner-led HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors with about 10 to 75 staff who pay for leads. Northwest Roof Restoration, LLC is exclusively a residential and commercial roofing contractor ('Everything Roofing') and does not offer HVAC, plumbing, or electrical services, placing it outside ForgeX's segment.
